context: A doctor explains digestive enzymes to a reporter
purpose: Teach: 酵素/混同/判る/落ち着か/投下/党員/政界/接待

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、消化酵素の働き、市民にも分かりやすく伝えたいですね。
lines.en: Ren, I'd like to communicate how digestive enzymes work in a way the general public can actually understand.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Measured pace. Leaning slightly forward with genuine intention — this matters to her. No rush, just clarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 添加物との混同、誤情報が多いです。
lines.en: There's a lot of confusion with food additives — misinformation gets in the way.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly concerned. Speaking from observation, not alarm. Soft emphasis on the word confusion. Genuine interest in the problem, not just stating facts.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。正しい仕組み、判るように、図解を加えました。
lines.en: Exactly. I've added diagrams so the mechanism is clear to readers.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Brief warmth on 'exactly' — she's pleased he sees it. Businesslike but not cold. Matter-of-fact about the solution.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 落ち着かない患者の不安、減らせると思います。
lines.en: I think it could actually reduce the anxiety we see in restless patients.
lines.style: Thoughtful, building quiet confidence. Soft emphasis on 'reduce' — real stakes here. Slower on the word anxiety, like he's recognizing something important. Genuine observation, not optimism.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 医療界に投下する啓発資料、続けて作成します。
lines.en: We'll keep producing educational materials and getting them into the medical community.
lines.style: Resolved, steady. Slight emphasis on 'keep' — a commitment. Calm determination. No theatrics, just professional conviction. Slight pause before the second clause.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 党員候補や政界も、関心を寄せていますね。
lines.en: I've noticed party candidates and political figures are paying attention too.
lines.style: Observational, slightly curious. Conversational but careful — he's noticing something unexpected. Even pace. Not accusatory, just noting the fact.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 接待絡みではない、地道な政策が要ります。
lines.en: Good policy takes time and care — not entertainment for officials' calendars.
lines.style: Quiet firmness underneath. Slow, deliberate. A touch of weariness but also resolve. Not bitter, just clear about what matters. Trailing thoughtfulness at the end.
